image_description: A vintage white gas stove with four burners. On the stovetop, there are three pans: a black frying pan on the left containing dark cooked food (possibly onions or meat), a small saucepan in the front left containing boiling water with a ladle, and a cast iron skillet on the right burner which appears empty but used. There is also a blue mug filled with walnuts and a small white bowl with more walnuts and tongs. The stove has chrome accents and control knobs on the front panel.
